<div class="pvme-wiki-export" style="max-width:84em;margin:0 auto;line-height:1.7;overflow-wrap:break-word;">
<span id="miscellaneous-vorago-mechanics-interactions-and-glitches" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
= <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><nowiki>Miscellaneous Vorago Mechanics, Interactions and Glitches</nowiki></span> =
<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed pvme-export-media-meta" style="margin:0.8em 0;padding:0.6em 0.8em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;max-width:100%;"><strong>Contents</strong><div class="mw-collapsible-content" style="max-height:24em;overflow:auto;">
{{ToC|align=none|clear=none|width=100%|limit=2}}
</div></div>


<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>This is a collection of various miscellaneous mechanics and glitches that can occur during the Vorago encounter for both normal mode and hard mode. These tips can range from very helpful (to the point where dps strategies rely on them) to just knowing them for the sake of trivia. These are generally organized by phase. Some of this information is already listed on the RS Wiki but for the sake of completion I will reiterate them here. This is not an extensive list of all glitches and misc. tips as I’m sure there are more to be discovered. Unless stated otherwise, all of these apply to both normal mode and hard mode.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="pre-fight" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Pre-Fight</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="challenge-timer" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Challenge Timer</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago’s fight challenge operates on a timer of 20 seconds. If you teleport away after you’ve accepted Vorago’s challenge to fight, and you travel back to the Face area within the 20 seconds, Vorago will still start the encounter and bring everyone into P1.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential application: If you teleport away, do not return to the Face area within 20 seconds unless you wish to join the fight.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="fake-dropdown" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Fake Dropdown</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ There are some methods wherein you can take the dropdown damage but not enter the fight. One method of doing so is to open the “change username” interface, though you do not need to change your username – just have the interface open. The dropdown damage will still calculate as if you will join the fight (eg. In a team of five, the dropdown damage will be 10k even though only four people enter the kill).</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential application: This could be used to lessen dropdown damage without having to enter p1 and lobby thereafter, in the event you need to get someone with low HP into the fight.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="rest-animation" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Rest Animation</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If you are in a rest animation when someone initiates the fight challenge prompt, you will not receive the challenge prompt until you have left the rest animation.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential application: Don’t accidentally not accept the challenge prompt by resting at Face.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="lucky-and-dropdown-damage" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Lucky and Dropdown Damage</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The Lucky perk can proc on the dropdown damage. Defenders and Armour set effects such as the Saradomin Warpriest effect can also proc on the dropdown damage nulling it to 1.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential applications: Get lucky and take 1 damage instead of 12500. This is unlikely to be useful for regular kills however.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="powerburst-of-vitality" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Powerburst of Vitality</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Dropdown is 20 seconds after challenge, so you can time using the powerburst of vitality by using a defensive ability like Preparation. Then right when it has some time before it comes back, you can use the powerburst right then to start the fight with more health than if you just used a phoenix necklace. You can also bring only one dose if you don't need it for the rest of the kill so you can equip your 2H weapons without needing to eat something else.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="tutorial-on-14k-entry-hits" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Tutorial on 14k Entry Hits</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="order-to-maximize-hp" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Order to Maximize HP</nowiki></span> ===

<ol style="margin:0.7em 0 1em;padding-left:1.8em;">
<li style="margin:0.4em 0;line-height:1.65;">
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Bonfire with all of your HP-boosting gear; if you have a thermal flask, use it prior to bonfiring</nowiki></p>
</li>
<li style="margin:0.4em 0;line-height:1.65;">
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Load your preset with your shield equipped</nowiki></p>
</li>
<li style="margin:0.4em 0;line-height:1.65;">
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Activate Fortitude</nowiki></p>
</li>
<li style="margin:0.4em 0;line-height:1.65;">
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Eat a rocktail/sailfish soup</nowiki></p>
</li>
<li style="margin:0.4em 0;line-height:1.65;">
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Lobby</nowiki></p>
</li>
<li style="margin:0.4em 0;line-height:1.65;">
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>You should be 14k+ hp without needing to keep prayer activated, just don't take off any hp boosting items (e.g. shield) or load another preset, else your hp disappears</nowiki></p>
</li>
</ol>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="phase-1" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Phase 1</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="less-bombs-on-p1" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Less Bombs on P1</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Once the TL5 reaches the top rock and vokes Vorago, Vorago will throw less auto attacks and often have a longer delay between auto attacks, provided no one else is standing in MD (ie. Base should not voke and stand MD until around 30k hp).</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential application: In trios, this lessens the number of blues and red bombs the Bomb Tank has to take during P1</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="tl5-corner-and-attack-range" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>TL5 Corner and Attack Range</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Assuming the Base lures Vorago to the North West quadrant so that the TL5 takes bombs as he climbs to the voke spot, the far North West corner of the TL5 path is often too far away from Vorago’s attack range. Thus, if the TL5 spends too long in the corner of the North West section, Vorago will start throwing bombs to the next furthest person which is usually the Bomb Tank.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential application: The TL5 should run past the North West corner as fast as possible to avoid sending bombs to the Bomb Tank in trios.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="how-to-lobby-p1" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>How to Lobby P1</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If the TL5 is standing on the top platform and vokes Vorago, the rest of the team can run to the South wall and exit combat to lobby. Vorago may throw occasionally throw blue bombs to the people running Southward, though, he will do it so infrequently that you should still be able to lobby in between blue bombs.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential application: Lobby p1 if someone dies and you don’t want to invest more to further the kill.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="jump-damage-null" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Jump Damage Null</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Upon the TL5 clicking to jump on Vorago, all incoming damage will be nulled on the tick when the TL5 clicks to jump.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential application: If Vorago is close to HP reset and the TL5 sees someone doing a wild magic that will reset the HP, the TL5 can click to jump and immediately null any incoming damage, preventing an HP reset.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="tl5-staying-in-combat" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>TL5 Staying in Combat</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The jump animation is exactly 17 seconds. As the TL5, it is possible to stay in combat during the jump animation. This requires the TL5 to do an ability on the tick you click to jump. If you do an ability and wait a couple ticks before jump, you will have exited combat and lost adren during the jump animation.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential application: This is a way for the TL5 to keep adren during jump and threshold after jump to end p1 faster.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="movement-after-jump" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Movement After Jump</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If the Base moves away from MD during the jump animation, Vorago will follow the Base as if Vorago is still in MD. However, Vorago will not visibly move as he is stuck in the jump animation. After the jump animation is over and the TL5 reaches the ground, Vorago’s character will “teleport” to be MD of where-ever the Base has walked to.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential application: In duos, the Base can escape during the jump animation. If the Bomb/TL5 happens to have a red bomb on them, the red bomb won’t deal 3k damage as the Base is far enough away. Be sure to walk one step north after you’ve escaped to prevent Vorago from moonwalking around the Base.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ After Vorago has moved to the Base’s MD post-jump, Vorago will not move from that location unless the Base steps under him.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential application: If no one is standing MD, Vorago will continue to throw blue bombs to the Bomb Tank. The Base can step away from Vorago’s MD and devo-cept the Bomb Tank.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="1-hp-glitch" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>1 HP Glitch</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago will regenerate HP on phase 1 at 1:09 (also 2:09, 3:09, etc.), if Vorago regenerates HP while jumping around before the phase transition, Vorago can have random aggro at the start of p2 meaning the first bleed on p2 will also be to a random person. Vorago can also start throwing blues and potentially reds. The blue and red bombs can follow you through the phase transition damage you upon p2 dropdown.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential applications: The Base should Target Cycle as soon as possible on p2 to ensure that Base has aggro on p2.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">

<span id="solo-luring-vorago-no-tl5-voke-required" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Solo Luring Vorago (No TL5 Voke Required)</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<span id="solo-luring-in-hard-mode-from-the-east-wall" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Solo Luring in Hard Mode from the East Wall</nowiki></span> ===

<span id="crack-healing" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Crack Healing</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="mechanics" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>During a phase transition at Vorago, your character is immune for 1 tick. You can take advantage of this by using the spell Heal Other from the Lunar Spellbook and cast the heal at the same time as a phase transition.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Normally, Heal Other will take hp from your character and transfer it to your target player; this results in a large 3-7k typeless &quot;hit&quot; on your character that is unavoidable. However, as your character is immune during a phase transition, the Heal Other will not damage your character. Thus, your target player will gain hp at no cost to you.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>This works on any phase transition at Vorago in both normal mode and hard mode (with the exception of p10 -&gt; p11 at hard mode).</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="how-to-perform-a-crack-heal" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>How to Perform a Crack Heal</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Be on the Lunar Spellbook and select the spell Heal Other.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Click your target player when the floor shows cracks, right before it collapses.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Important Notes</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Your target player must have Accept Aid turned ON in their settings.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If you mess up and perform the Heal Other too early/late, the spell will take hp from your character and transfer it to your target.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Heal Group can be used as well, though it requires your target player(s) to be within 1 square of you. Easiest way to achieve this is to ask your partner to follow you, or vice versa.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>See video for examples: </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/3bMTu1YJIbQ <nowiki>https://youtu.be/3bMTu1YJIbQ</nowiki>]</p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="phase-2" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Phase 2</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="invisible-first-bleed" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Invisible First Bleed</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The first bleed of P2 does not have a character animation as Vorago is still in his dropdown animation.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential application: Clear the first bleed by using freedom first, then tag and voke if you are the Base.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="1-tick-bleed-clear" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>1 Tick Bleed Clear</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ It is possible to clear the bleed in 1 tick by first escaping, then bladed diving back onto Vorago within the same tick. You must target Vorago with the bladed dive, targeting the ground for MD will not work and will make Vorago walk towards you. You must avoid standing on the corner of Vorago’s MD as this will also make Vorago walk toward you after you’ve escaped.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential application: This is another way to keep Vorago in Base spot while clearing bleeds without freedom.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="instant-bleed-clear" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Instant Bleed Clear</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ After a bleed is applied, there is a couple ticks delay between when the bleed is applied to when the dismember icon appears on the debuff bar. It is possible to clear a bleed before the dismember bleed icon appears on your debuff bar.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential application: You can clear bleeds faster than you think.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="voke-splash" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Voke Splash</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ It is possible to have a voke splash on P2, and (likely) all other phases of the boss too. If a player vokes Vorago and another player is standing within the path of Vorago and the voker, Vorago will aggro onto the person standing in-between instead.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential applications: Avoid voking Vorago while standing behind another player. See clip: </nowiki>[https://clips.twitch.tv/FrigidDeafMooseThisIsSparta <nowiki>https://clips.twitch.tv/FrigidDeafMooseThisIsSparta</nowiki>]</p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="clearing-all-bleeds-solo" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Clearing All Bleeds Solo</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ It is possible to clear all five bleeds solo. The order is escape/surge, bladed dive, freedom, escape/surge, bladed dive. Note a mobile perk is needed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential application: Clear all five bleeds solo in case of dead teammates.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="2k-typeless-damage" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>2k Typeless Damage</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Sometimes, after Bring Him Down, all players in the arena will take a 2k typeless hit immediately after the spam click mechanic. It is unclear what triggers this though it is believe to be an “anti-afk” where if players ignore Vorago for too long, Vorago will perform the 2k typeless hit (similar to how you must stay in combat in Yaka). This 2k typeless hit can also be encountered during P1 if the TL5 vokes Vorago and everyone else lobbies, but the TL5 stays in the kill and exits combat. The TL5 will proceed to take 2k typeless hits. It seems the entire team must exit combat for this bleed to occur, though confirmation on this is needed.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential applications: Keep above 2k HP after Bring Him Down just in case.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="stuck-under-vorago" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Stuck Under Vorago</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ During Bring Him Down, it is possible to get stuck under Vorago after the spam click mechanic. This is usually triggered by standing under Vorago during the Bring Him Down mechanic.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential applications: Avoid standing under Vorago during Bring Him Down.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="bring-him-down-dps-check" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Bring Him Down – DPS Check</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The Bring Him Down DPS check to make Vorago stumble is 50k Hp no matter the team size. This is rather trivial to do in a team size of 3+ but becomes harder in Duos.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential applications: Do approx. 50k worth of damage during Bring Him Down to get past the mechanic.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="bring-him-down-staying-in-combat" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Bring Him Down – Staying in Combat</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Occasionally, it is possible to exit combat and drop adren during the Bring Him Down spam click mechanic. This usually occurs when players have refreshed their combat state before the last Gravity Orb is tagged.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential applications: To avoid dropping combat and losing adren during Bring Him Down, do a defensive ability during the spam click mechanic, such as anticipate.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="centring-vorago" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Centring Vorago</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Knowing how to walk Vorago is useful for moving him on phase 2.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>First determine his walking direction. Step one tile under Vorago and immediately cast an ability to walk him one tile in his walking direction.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: If you do not cast an ability he may walk on top of you and around to the other side.</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Once you determine Vorago's walking direction, it is easiest to manipulate his position from the opposite side, i.e. if Vorago is walking west, stand on the east side of him.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>In order to move Vorago, he must be following you. During phase 2, Vorago does not follow between the red bomb and start of bleeds. This means if you step out of melee distance expecting Vorago to follow you after the red, he will stand there until bleeds begin. However, he can be walked under which will cause him to move in the direction he is walking.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>If Vorago is walking south, go west and bladed dive onto the square marked with the blue blubber jellyfish</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>​</nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Imgur link to image/gif expired.</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>To bring Vorago back to base spot when vorago is lured south during bleeds, step 2 squares north of the square west of L rock and provoke</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>​</nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Imgur link to image/gif expired.</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>If Vorago is north, step 2 squares south instead.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>​</nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Imgur link to image/gif expired.</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="how-to-tick-shatter-after-bring-him-down" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>How to Tick Shatter After Bring Him Down</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CXqNT7XOOHk&feature=youtu.be <nowiki>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CXqNT7XOOHk&amp;feature=youtu.be</nowiki>]</p>
<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:900px;margin:0.9em 0;"><youtube width=640 height=360>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CXqNT7XOOHk</youtube>
<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="font-size:0.85em;">[https://www.youtube.com/embed/CXqNT7XOOHk <nowiki>Video source</nowiki>]</span></div>

</div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="phase-3" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Phase 3</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="scopulus-aggro" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Scopulus – Aggro</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The Scopulus aggro seem to be random though there are a couple ways to trigger a reaggro. 1) If a player is constantly in motion, the Scopulus tend to aggro them more. 2) A player with an Ice Nihil will tend to draw more aggro, due to the Ice Nihil’s special effect acting on the Scops.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential applications: Bring a Smoke Nihil on Scop rotations to avoid drawing aggro.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="vitalis-base-spot-and-vitalis-spawn" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Vitalis – Base Spot and Vitalis Spawn</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If Vorago is not moved from the initial dropdown spot, the Vitalis Orb will always be sent North, North East, or East. If Vorago is moved from the initial dropdown spot, the Vitalis Orb can be send in any direction.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential application: Avoid moving Vorago to have a predictable Vitalis Orb spawn.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="vitalis-max-vitalis" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Vitalis – Max Vitalis</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The maximum number of Vitalis that can fill the room in Normal Mode is 15, the max in Hard Mode is 25. In Normal Mode, the number of Vitalis spawning per Orb is 5 on p3 and p4, and 2-4 on p5. In Hard Mode, there are 7 Vitalis on p5 and p9, and between 3 to 5 on p10 and p11.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential applications: If you want to block all Vitalis spawns, have the appropriate number of people standing in the spawn Orb.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="vitalis-death-animation" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Vitalis – Death Animation</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ A Vitalis minion is still treated as a physical object while in its death animation.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential application: If surrounded by Vitali, be vary of their death animations still counting as a physical object. Same applies to Waterfall on P4, your character will attempt to path around the dying Vitalis which may lead to exiting the waterfall prematurely. See clip: </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/-HOB3kLpHgI <nowiki>https://youtu.be/-HOB3kLpHgI</nowiki>]</p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="teamsplit-auto-attacks" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Teamsplit – Auto Attacks</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ During the teamsplit mechanic, if you attempt to cast an auto attack on Vorago while outside the max cast distance, your character will run into the max cast distance in an attempt to cast your spell. Often times this results in a player leaving the teamsplit box early and taking 8k damage.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential application: Do not attempt to auto cast while in teamsplit unless you are certain you are within 7 squares to Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="teamsplit-hard-mode" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Teamsplit – Hard Mode</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The teamsplit boxes in hardmode, although appearing to be only 1x1, are actually 1x2. The square directly east of the 1x1 square is also safe to stand on. The same applies to the teamsplit boxes on p10 and p11.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential application: Another safe square to stand on for team split.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="the-end-glitch-out-of-arms" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>The End – Glitch Out of Arms</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ It is possible to glitch out of the arms during the mechanic by standing directly on the South line, or East line, in the respective quadrants. When Vorago’s arm crosses said line, your character is free to move out into the open arena. Note that if you do not move after “glitching out” and stay standing on the South or East line, you will be forced back into the arms mechanic.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential applications: DPS can glitch out of arms and set up their Sun with ample space.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="the-end-bombs-after-phase" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>The End – Bombs after Phase</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago only allows bombs to be interacted with when it is pointed to in their respective quadrant. If Vorago happens to phase while looking at a specific quadrant, the bombs in that quadrant can still be activated while the phase transition is happening.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Potential applications: Tag the red bombs during a phase transition and ask for a group hug.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="how-to-dd-scops-on-spawn-using-backwards-target-cycle" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>How to DD Scops on Spawn Using Backwards Target Cycle</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<span id="getting-flank-on-scops-as-base" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Getting Flank on Scops as Base</nowiki></span> ===
